decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension with several models in the firm's core drainage range, it has accumulated enough sunk development and marketing commitment that management is likely to continue backing it.
This shower channel remains tightly aligned with the firm's core offer and its dedicated presentation indicates visible commitment, making withdrawal in the next year unlikely.

Although more specialized, the pump-assisted drainage line builds on the firm's know-how and future-ready bathroom strategy, so management is likely to attribute any slow uptake to a still-developing market and persist.
The tileable floor drain is a close fit with the established portfolio and has already been publicly backed, so escalation of commitment points clearly toward retention.
This design grate supports the firm's aesthetics-led positioning and complements existing systems, so despite being somewhat easier to prune than a full system product it is still likely to be kept.

As a 2024 pump-drain shower channel with its own page and clear strategic fit to barrier-free, future-ready drainage, it has enough visible commitment for management to give it more time rather than exit quickly.
